content.name: Abstraction toolkit v0 (create, store, prove and show abstractions)
content.lineage: Shares the Micro-energy circuit AtomDynamics law (the 'micro-electric' kit) at the SENSEMAKING scale, and inherits the seal-gate discipline of the Energy Pen (a claim is established only when measured support meets threshold). Where the Sky/Mechanical/Telecom/Underground toolkits program and act on THINGS, this one operates on ABSTRACTIONS — values, patterns, designs, claims, justifications. It is meta: it produces the very patterns, designs and justifications the other toolkits carry in their own justification and validation faces. See [[space:l2:lumina-prime:energy-pen-v0]].

parent_scope.justification: Portable bootstrap toolkit awaiting installation under the canonical sensemaking/physicalization registry Space. Exactly one scope classification; no PART_OF edge is written to an unbuilt parent.

content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. This toolkit is a reasoning grammar over that law: an abstraction is an atom (a proposition), a piece of evidence/justification is a support bond, a contradiction/counterexample is an inhibition bond, the required arguments are required_supports (an AND gate), the proof burden is the threshold, and 'proven' is a fire. Which abstraction MEANS what — a value, a pattern, a design — is payload data, never a term in the atom law.
content.purpose: Create, store, prove and show abstractions. CREATE: an author composes an abstraction — a Value, a Pattern, a Design, a Claim or a Justification — as a proposition (atom) with its intended content. STORE: it is committed to the graph with provenance and a signature over exact atoms and revisions, so it persists and can be cited. PROVE: it is established only by conducting MEASURED evidence/justification to its proof threshold with no standing contradiction — a proof is conducted evidence, never an assertion; a counterexample inhibits it. SHOW: it is physicalized with an HONEST proof state — proven is solid, supported-but-unproven is partial, unproven is Fog, refuted is struck through. An unproven abstraction is never shown as established, and a proof that a claim's evidence cannot bear is refused.

abstraction_contract.abstraction: a created reasoning artifact (Value | Pattern | Design | Claim | Justification | Question), physicalized as an atom whose fire = 'established/proven'
abstraction_contract.evidence: a support bond from a supporting abstraction/observation to the one it argues for; carries measured weight toward the proof threshold
abstraction_contract.contradiction: a counterexample/refutation, physicalized as an inhibition bond that blocks 'proven' without erasing the support already gathered
abstraction_contract.required_arguments: the arguments an abstraction MUST have to be provable, physicalized as required_supports (an AND gate) — e.g. a Design requires a justification AND its rejected alternatives
abstraction_contract.proof_burden: the threshold of measured support an abstraction must reach to count as proven
abstraction_contract.abstraction_of: generalization: a higher Pattern whose required_supports are its instances — it fires (the pattern holds) only when enough instances support it

validity_decomposition.note: Validity is NOT one scalar. An abstraction (and every construct, since a construct is a self-verifying loop) carries these FIVE orthogonal axes, each with its own epistemic status; they are never collapsed into a single 'healthy'.

causal_validity.question: does the causal/logical structure hold in principle? a-temporal, world-independent
causal_validity.established_by: proof over the causal structure (required arguments conduct, no logical contradiction) — the argument, not the current world

current_truth.question: does it actually hold in the world RIGHT NOW?
current_truth.established_by: fresh runtime evidence read by the observer (a runtime health_assessment)
current_truth.independence: a claim may be causally valid yet currently false (world not in that state), or currently true yet causally unsound (true by luck)

validity_degree.question: how STRONG is the validity?

parts.evidence_margin: measured_support minus proof_burden — how far above threshold
parts.validator_strength: the validity AND strength of the validators themselves: is the observer itself proven (observer-validation passing), independent, and how strong? A pass from a weak or unproven validator is a weak proof.

validity_degree.statuses: graded (u64 margin + validator provenance), never a bare pass/fail

validity_scope.question: over what domain does it hold? space, time, type/population, scale, revision range
validity_scope.rule: outside the declared scope an abstraction is OUT-OF-SCOPE, not false; a scope must be declared, never assumed universal

validity_context.question: under what assumptions / preconditions / situation does the above hold?
lives_in: the situation frame: universe revision, active actors, assumed premises
validity_context.rule: distinguish valid-under-context-C from valid-unconditionally; a context change may re-open any of the other four axes

abstraction_contract.rule: An abstraction is shown as PROVEN only when its measured support meets its proof burden AND no contradiction inhibits it; otherwise it is proposed/supported/contradicted/Fog. Evidence energy must be measured — an authored or unknown weight is refused. A signature covers exact atoms and revisions; mutating a proven abstraction invalidates its signature and re-opens its proof. Creating, evidencing or contradicting is an attributable act; a mere observer reads but does not alter the reasoning.

content.success_condition: For any created abstraction, its validity is shown as a VECTOR over five orthogonal axes, never a single scalar: (1) causal validity — does the causal/logical structure hold in principle; (2) current truth — does it hold in the world now; (3) degree — the evidence margin AND the validity/strength of the validators themselves; (4) scope — the declared domain where it holds, with out-of-scope distinct from false; (5) context — the assumptions/preconditions under which it holds. Each axis is a faithful projection of MEASURED evidence with its own status; causally-valid-but-currently-false, currently-true-but-causally-unsound, proven-by-a-weak-validator, in-scope-only, and conditional-on-context all remain separately visible. Every abstraction is stored with provenance and a signature over exact atoms and revisions; mutating a proven abstraction invalidates its signature and re-opens the affected axes. No axis is ever collapsed to hide another, and no proof is admitted from unmeasured or contradicted evidence.

content.pattern: A bounded reasoning Space holds abstractions and carries no energy of its own. Each abstraction physicalizes as an atom (roleAxis narrative — an attractor that holds a proposition); its required arguments are its required_supports (an AND gate). A piece of evidence/justification is a support bond that conducts measured weight toward the proof burden; a contradiction is an inhibition bond that blocks 'proven' without erasing gathered support. To PROVE, run_until_quiescent conducts the evidence: an abstraction fires (becomes proven) only when its measured support meets threshold, its required arguments all conducted, and no contradiction inhibits it. To SHOW, the abstraction is rendered with a proof state that mirrors its atom state — proven solid, supported partial, contradicted blocked, unproven Fog. To STORE is to commit it with provenance and a signature; to CREATE is to author it. A Pattern generalized from instances is a higher atom whose required_supports are those instances.
content.epistemic_honesty: A proven abstraction is one whose evidence actually conducted, not one asserted. A drawn evidence line is a committed support bond, not a hope. A contradicted claim is blocked, not quietly proven. An unproven abstraction is Fog — proposed or unknown — never confident knowledge. Reading the reasoning is not altering it.

terms.ReasoningSpace: The bounded Space that holds one web of abstractions; roleAxis space, carries no energy, bounds the reasoning.
terms.Abstraction: A created reasoning artifact (Value, Pattern, Design, Claim, Justification, Question) physicalized as an atom whose fire = proven/established.
terms.Value: A held commitment or criterion an abstraction can be judged against.
terms.Pattern: A generalization abstracted from instances; a higher atom whose required_supports are its instances — it holds only when enough instances support it.
terms.Design: A proposed structure carrying its justification and its rejected alternatives; provable only when both are present and uncontradicted.
terms.Claim: A single proposition that may be supported, proven, contradicted or refuted.
terms.Evidence: A support bond conducting measured weight toward an abstraction's proof burden.
terms.Contradiction: A counterexample/refutation; an inhibition bond that blocks 'proven' without erasing gathered support.
terms.Proof: The conducted, measured support sub-graph that fires an abstraction at its proof burden with no standing contradiction — never a bare assertion.
terms.ProofBurden: The support threshold an abstraction must reach to count as proven.
terms.Signature: A validity claim over exact atoms and revisions; mutating a proven abstraction invalidates it and re-opens the proof.
terms.Fog: A proposed, unknown or not_measured abstraction; shown dark/translucent, never as established knowledge.

content.given: An authored abstraction (its kind, content and required arguments), pieces of measured evidence/justification, any contradictions, and the acting actor's capability set.
content.when: An author creates an abstraction, stores it, adds evidence, raises a contradiction, requests a proof, or an observer reads the reasoning.
then: CREATE: admit the abstraction as a proposition (atom) with its required arguments as required_supports; it starts unproven (Fog).
STORE: commit it to the graph with provenance and a signature over exact atoms and revisions.
PROVE: run the evidence circuit — the abstraction fires (proven) only when its measured support meets its proof burden, all required arguments conducted, and no contradiction inhibits it.
Hold a contradicted or under-supported abstraction unproven; never fabricate a proof it cannot bear.
SHOW: physicalize each abstraction with a proof state faithful to its atom state (proven / supported / contradicted / Fog).
Serve reads as observe-only; resolve create/evidence/contradict/store against the authoring capability, failing an unauthorized one closed with a receipt.
forbidden: reading an abstraction's kind or meaning inside the native AtomDynamics law
showing an unproven or contradicted abstraction as established
admitting a proof from authored, derived, unknown or not_measured evidence
firing 'proven' while a contradiction inhibits the abstraction
firing a Design/Pattern without all its required arguments conducted
drawing an evidence line where no support bond exists
conducting an evidence or contradiction bond more than once
holding a signature valid after its proven abstraction mutated
erasing gathered support when a contradiction arrives
presenting a rendered proof animation as an actual proof

steps: CREATE: read the authored abstraction (kind, content, required arguments); map it to an atom whose required_supports are its required arguments
STORE: commit the abstraction with provenance; compute a signature over its exact atoms and revisions
map each evidence/justification to a support bond, each contradiction to an inhibition bond
admit only measured evidence weight through the membrane
PROVE: run_until_quiescent — fire an abstraction iff support >= proof burden, all required arguments received, and not inhibited by a contradiction
hold under-supported or contradicted abstractions unproven (Fog)
verify admitted integer evidence weight is conserved
assign each abstraction a proof state: proposed / supported / proven / contradicted / refuted / unknown / not_measured
SHOW: render each abstraction faithful to its proof state, without inventing certainty
for a mutation of a proven abstraction: invalidate its prior signature and re-open its proof
for a read: resolve the observe-only set; for authoring: require the authoring capability, else fail closed
emit the commit or rejection receipt; run the independent observer and structured evaluation AST; derive health from fresh evidence
content.proof_rule: proven(a) iff measured_support(a) >= proof_burden(a) AND all required_arguments(a) conducted AND not contradicted(a); otherwise proposed/supported/contradicted/Fog.
content.capability_resolution: read -> observe-only-set; authoring_port -> require(authoring_capability). No affordance escalates capability; an absent capability fails closed.

authoring_gate.rule: Creating, evidencing, contradicting or storing an abstraction is admitted only from an actor holding authority:abstraction-authoring. Reading grants none of it. A proof is admitted only from measured evidence.

proof_circuit.note: GENERIC illustrative reasoning: a Design abstraction is proven only when BOTH its justification and its rejected-alternatives argument conduct (an AND gate at proof_burden 200); a counterexample can inhibit it. A real reasoning web supplies ANY abstractions + evidence + contradictions; the toolkit hard-codes no particular claim.

atoms.note: proof_burden 200 = both required arguments; a single unit of contradiction blocks 'proven'

bonds.note: the justification argues for the design
a counterexample; if it charges, the design is contradicted, not proven — support is not erased

proof_circuit.proof_note: With both supports conducting (200 >= 200) and no counterexample charged, the design fires = PROVEN. Inject 1 into counterexample and the design stays unproven (contradicted) while keeping its 200 support — honest, re-openable.

content.honesty: The portable Abstraction toolkit is materialized and structurally shaped as a construct. This field is written BEFORE injection; after an injector commits it, the on-disk graph carries the construct while this embedded field reads stale (WRITTEN but not wired, executed, or proven healthy). No abstraction is proved or shown yet.

why: Reasoning artifacts — values, patterns, designs, justifications — need a first-class home; without one they live as prose the system cannot check, cite or re-open.

Making 'proven' a FIRE gated by measured support means a claim cannot be established by assertion: an under-supported or contradicted abstraction simply does not fire, so the difference between opinion and proof is measurable.
Modelling contradiction as inhibition (blocking without erasing support) gives honest refutation: a counterexample re-opens a proof instead of silently deleting the case for it.
Modelling generalization as an AND gate over instances makes a Pattern hold only when enough instances actually support it, so abstraction is earned, not declared.
Signing over exact atoms and revisions makes tampering detectable: mutate a proven abstraction and its signature falls and the proof re-opens.
Being the meta-toolkit — the place other toolkits' patterns, designs and justifications are created and proved — keeps reasoning uniform across the whole system.
rejected: treating an asserted claim as proven, because assertion is not conducted evidence
proof from unmeasured weight, because energy is conserved gating, not persuasion
a contradiction that erases support, because refutation should re-open a case, not delete it
declaring a Pattern from a single instance, because generalization must be supported by enough instances
holding a signature valid after its claim mutated, because that hides tampering
a rendered proof animation as a proof, because a picture is not conducted evidence

negative_invariants: neutral bond with nonzero energy rejected
proof asserted without conducted evidence rejected
invariants: an abstraction is proven only with measured support at or above its proof burden and no standing contradiction
all required arguments conducted before a Design/Pattern fires
a contradiction blocks proof without erasing gathered support
a Pattern holds only when enough instances support it
every stored abstraction carries provenance and a signature over exact atoms and revisions
mutating a proven abstraction invalidates its signature and re-opens its proof
admitted integer evidence weight is conserved
every evidence and contradiction bond conducts at most once
an unproven or contradicted abstraction is never shown as established
every authoring affordance resolves to the authoring capability

tests: detect an abstraction shown as proven whose evidence did not conduct to threshold
detect a proof admitted from unmeasured evidence
detect a 'proven' fire while a contradiction inhibits the abstraction
detect a Design/Pattern fired without all required arguments
detect a Pattern declared from too few instances
detect a signature still valid after its proven abstraction mutated
detect an evidence or contradiction bond conducted twice
detect a contradiction that erased gathered support
detect an authoring affordance offered to an actor without the capability
detect a rendered proof animation presented as a proof
never convert an unproven abstraction into an established one

content.independence: Reads each abstraction and its kind/content, its required arguments, the evidence and contradiction bonds, the physicalized proof trace, final atom states, the signatures, the provenance, the acting capability set and the catalog. It does not trust a runtime-declared proof state, a renderer animation, or an author's self-report of certainty.
checks: every 'proven' abstraction reached its proof burden with measured support
no proof was admitted from unmeasured evidence
all required arguments conducted before a Design/Pattern fired
a Pattern held only with enough instances
contradictions blocked proof without erasing support
every stored abstraction has provenance and a signature over exact atoms and revisions
signatures invalidate on mutation and proofs re-open
single conduction per evidence and contradiction bond
proof state shown faithfully (Fog for unproven)
every authoring affordance requires the authoring capability

content.note: Health is NOT one scalar here. It is a VECTOR over the five orthogonal validity axes (see content.abstraction_contract.validity_decomposition); each axis carries its own status and is never collapsed into a single 'healthy'.

causal_validity.derivation: proven when the causal argument's required supports conducted and no logical contradiction stands — established over the structure, independent of the current world

current_truth.derivation: holds_now only from a fresh runtime health_assessment reading the current world; may differ from causal_validity in either direction

validity_degree.derivation: graded from the evidence margin (support minus burden) AND validator_strength (is the observer itself proven via observer-validation, independent, strong?); a pass from a weak/unproven validator is weak

validity_scope.derivation: in_scope within the declared rayon; out-of-scope is not a failure; scope_undeclared is itself a defect (universality must not be assumed)

validity_context.derivation: unconditional only when no unmet precondition or assumption is required; otherwise conditional_on_context with the context named

content.collapse_forbidden: No single overall health may hide a per-axis defect: causally-valid-but-currently-false, currently-true-but-causally-unsound, proven-by-a-weak-validator, in-scope-only, or conditional-on-context must each remain separately visible.
content.measurement_failed: The observer or evaluator failed to produce a trustworthy measurement on one or more axes; the failing axis is named, never converted to a pass.

content.name: Abstraction authoring port (create / evidence / contradict / store)
content.note: Reading and tracing the reasoning is a separate observe-only surface; this port is the ONLY authoring surface. A proof, additionally, is admitted only from measured evidence — capability lets you argue, it does not let you assert a proof.
